text:
Raat kitni hi lambi kyun na ho,
Subah ki pehli kiran apna rasta dhoond hi leti hai.
Akelepan ke andheron se ladkar,
Dekho toh, ek nayi umeed fir se jag uthi hai.
title: Nayi Subah Ka Ehsaas
description: Ek khubsurat aur uplifting status post jo lambi raat ke baad aane wali subah aur umeed ki baat karta hai.
